name: io.github.cookinfun/cookin-mcp
description: Solana and Pump.fun token intelligence: bundles, holder quality, KOLs, deployer history.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base58 Solana keypair holding USDC, to pay per call with x402. The key stays on this machine; only a signed transaction leaves it.

environmentVariables.name: COOKIN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Cookin Pro API key, as an alternative to paying per call. Mint one at https://cookin.fun/account/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: COOKIN_MAX_PAYMENT
environmentVariables.description: Most one call may pay, for example $0.05. Default $0.05.
